title.zh: 固定 N=64 Weideman 等离子体色散函数

summary: Evaluate the source-method N=64 rational Faddeeva approximation and its branch labels.

identity.relation: dimensionless complex z to approximate w(z), Z(z) and method flags
identity.direction: dimensionless complex z to approximate w(z), Z(z) and method flags
identity.definition: Z(z)=i sqrt(pi) w(z), with N=64 Weideman FFT coefficients and the source's pure-imaginary erfc and lower-half-plane reflection branches.
identity.model: homogeneous Maxwellian plasma dispersion special function
identity.coordinates: complex argument plane; array axes belong to the caller
identity.boundary: finite representable arguments outside numerical poles of the rational approximation
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: z
inputs.description: 待求的复变量取值。可为标量、任意形状的实数或复数 `array_like`；轴含义由调用方决定，本算子不解释物理轴。单位：无量纲（归一化相速度 z = omega/(k*vt)）。有效性约束：元素须为有限值（不含 `NaN`/`inf`），实部为 0 的元素走精确 erfc 分支，实部非 0 且虚部为负的元素走共轭反射分支。
inputs.constraints: 元素须为有限值（不含 `NaN`/`inf`），实部为 0 的元素走精确 erfc 分支，实部非 0 且虚部为负的元素走共轭反射分支。

outputs.name: Z
outputs.description: 等离子体色散函数值 Z(z)=1i*sqrt(pi)*w(z)。形状与 `z` 完全一致（标量输入得 0 维数组），复数值 `ndarray`（complex128）。单位：无量纲。有效性约束：仅在 `z` 各元素有限且未落在展开式极点附近时数值有效；实部为 0 的实参数点给出纯虚结果。
outputs.shape: same shape as z; scalar gives a zero-dimensional array
outputs.constraints: 仅在 `z` 各元素有限且未落在展开式极点附近时数值有效；实部为 0 的实参数点给出纯虚结果。

outputs.name: w
outputs.description: Faddeeva 函数 w(z)=exp(-z^2)*erfc(-1i*z)。形状与 `z` 一致，复数值 `ndarray`。单位：无量纲。有效性约束：虚部为负且实部非 0 的输入返回的是共轭反射后的下半平面值，而非上半平面解析延拓值。
outputs.shape: same shape as z; scalar gives a zero-dimensional array
outputs.constraints: 虚部为负且实部非 0 的输入返回的是共轭反射后的下半平面值，而非上半平面解析延拓值。

outputs.name: method
outputs.description: 逐元素字符串标记，取 `'erfc'`（real(z)==0）或 `'rational'`（其余）。形状与 `z` 一致，`object` 数组。单位：无量纲（枚举标签）。有效性约束：取值必为这两个字符串之一。
outputs.shape: same shape as z; scalar gives a zero-dimensional array
outputs.constraints: 取值必为这两个字符串之一。

outputs.name: all_purely_imaginary
outputs.description: 布尔标量，为 True 表示 `z` 全部元素满足 real(z)==0，即触发源码 frozen source 的提前返回。单位：无量纲（布尔）。有效性约束：与 `method` 全为 `'erfc'` 互为充要条件。
outputs.constraints: 与 `method` 全为 `'erfc'` 互为充要条件。

preconditions: finite representable arguments outside numerical poles of the rational approximation
supported: Evaluate the source-method N=64 rational Faddeeva approximation and its branch labels.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.

failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the calculated tensor or function value is nonfinite.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative root solve is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

example.expected: The asserted result follows the declared output contract.

scope: Declared source-method numerical case and relevant failure boundaries.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct Python tests establish only the listed finite cases and tolerances; source parity, arbitrary-parameter accuracy and release approval are outside that evidence.
known_limitations: finite representable arguments outside numerical poles of the rational approximation
